question: MLAs in which of the following states/UTs received an increase of about 66% in salaries and allowances w.e.f. 14 February 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Delhi**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Delhi** MLAs received an increase of about 66% in salaries and allowances effective from 14 February 2023.
 
• This increase includes various components such as basic salary, constituency allowance, and communication allowance among others.
 
• The decision was taken to ensure that the compensation reflects the responsibilities and duties of the MLAs.
 
• Such increments aim to provide better financial security and encourage dedicated public service.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Delhi** is a Union Territory with a Legislative Assembly.
 
• The Assembly was established in 1993, and it has the power to legislate on matters except public order, police, and land.
 
• The Chief Minister of Delhi is the head of the government, and the Lieutenant Governor is the representative of the President of India in Delhi.
 
• Periodic revisions in the salaries and allowances of MLAs help in maintaining their financial well-being and enabling them to perform their duties efficiently.
